notes.title: UnLoop Demo
notes.notes: [h3]Hi![/h3][p]As mentioned before, UnLoop is taking part in the VR Forever Steam Festival. [/p][p]We’ve got a PCVR demo ready, and though right now its Steam page is still stuck in the review queue – you can grab the demo directly and give it a try.[/p][p][/p][h3]How to run it:[/h3][p]Step 1: Download the .zip (download link is in our Discord – [url="https://discord.gg/HQfWKaXqx6"]https://discord.gg/HQfWKaXqx6[/url] #unloop-news channel, and extract it into a folder)[/p][p]Step 2: Connect your headset and start SteamVR[/p][p]Step 3: Run the game’s .exe from the folder you just extracted[/p][p][/p][h3]Works with: [/h3][p]Meta Quest & Pico headsets. Support for more headsets and controllers is planned for the full release.[/p][p][/p][h3]The demo includes 8 introductory levels [/h3][p]Where you can test your skills, get used to the gameplay loop, and try out the first two puzzle mechanics: cards and batteries![/p][p]Visuals in the demo are identical to those on the Meta Quest 3/3S because this demo is a port of the standalone version of the game. We plan to improve these for the full PCVR release.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: UnLoop demo is coming soon!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048585/551267b6047936f773f1bc198d0dcbbc718724ab.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello to everyone who follows UnLoop on Steam, and thanks for all your recent wishlists! Our news will be short:
[/p][p]a) We are working on the PCVR version of the game and it’s set to be released later this year.[/p][p]b) We’ll have a short [b]Steam demo[/b] available as a part of [b]VR Forever Steam Fest (Sept 18 – 23)[/b].
[/p][p]The demo will feature a set of levels for you to try, visually mostly resembling Quest 3 build ported to PCVR. We haven’t had much time with it yet, so future Steam release will obviously get more improvements.
[/p][p]In the meantime, you can join our Discord to hang out – [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/HQfWKaXqx6"]https://discord.gg/HQfWKaXqx6[/url][/p][p] [/p]
